title: Oleshky ceasefire begins, Budanov says
summary: A ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid to enter the Russian occupied city began as Russian forces launched ballistic missiles at other parts of Ukraine.

title: Russia's assault on Ukraine's energy grid is a war crime, UN says
summary: Russia’s attacks on energy infrastructure, which weaponize winter to inflict suffering, amount to war crimes, a UN inquiry has found.

title: Ukrainian media face pressure as they step up scrutiny of authorities in wartime
summary: "An environment is gradually taking shape in which it is becoming increasingly difficult for journalists to do their jobs," Inna Vedernikova, a journalist at the Ukrainian newspaper Dzerkalo Tyzhnia, told the Kyiv Independent. "The space for freedom of speech is shrinking."

title: Russian sabotage network behind Romanian arson attack, officials say
summary: The attack is "part of a larger campaign of sabotage operations attributed to the Russian Federation in Europe," according to the Romanian Intelligence Service.

title: New report tracks how Russia helps China build better drones
summary: The investigation found that Russian designs for rocket-launched drones likely helped shape weapons China unveiled in 2025 and that Russian wind tunnels kept testing aircraft models for China's top arms maker after the invasion of Ukraine.

title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian ammunition depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast
summary: Ukraine used strike drones in an attack that took several hours near the city of Khrustalnyi, according to Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova Plus.
